notes.title: Winter Season Update - Release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/2447e6676864b862b67ae4d6d85f3e9c86102514.png
Chestnuts roasting on an open fire, snow falling lightly on a dusky morn. Winter is here and Jack Frost sends his regards. The Winter Season Update today goes in full swing, so grab your coats and lets get into it!

Battle Rank Season 7For Season 7 we have re-evaluated how we distribute Warchests completely. Instead of receiving one Aces High every level, we've made the switch to reward the Battalion faithful every five levels with the new Winter Warchest. This will make your Seasonal venture feel all the more rewarding as a greater gift in your stocking every five levels is for us a step in the right direction for a more consistent flow. 

With Season 7 we've also implemented a new breakdown of XP so that our players know exactly what they're being rewarded for and where their XP comes from. This will be presented as it was at the end of the game 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/8d0105fbb3222817e1b900095341fa3940850f5e.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/1c94808ebc09cf844be1f2afeca7e5f4e4b7ebc9.png

This Season's skins focus on everything the holidays has to offer, from gifts and decorations to the occasional penguin. With the new distribution system in place these skins have never been easier to acquire with the option to purchase still freely available for those who wish to continue supporting the game. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/6917ab38ae449accaa5cfc7289978ca819536187.png

Special Event: 3v3 New season, new event. This time we're looking to bring our players closer together during the festive period, quite literally. With two bombsites, twelve coins and six rounds to fight for, this mode brings a shorter, more action packed experience to the frontline. Alongside the game mode itself we'll be seeing our four aim maps enter the fray. Aimmap, Kosak, and variations on Liberation and Coastal make for quick paced game mode for you to dip in and out of as you see fit. For the first week of 3v3 Wartide, XP shall remain the same as its competitive variant to help give you a little holiday boost into the new season. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/a5c4b1d2ee13110ee38fb5393729404d9f570f7f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/d2030c8894a7c51905bab12fd5b1302ed187ef81.png

Streamer and Hidden Name ModeAs part of our continued roadmap we've added a Streaming and Hidden Name mode which will allow those that stream to do so without the trouble of finding themselves at the end of untoward names or chat. Enabling these will change the names of team mates and enemies alike and give them a name of a more family friendly nature.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/27969186e1327b91b8994908157025f3d0af581b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/a1e7236177784d94354951cd7f28c17cda88cf4c.png

The training menu will be consistently updated with new content from the more basic aspects of the game up to full breakdowns of Wartide, other game modes and complicated mechanics by some of the best and brightest from both in house and the community
! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/7ae8d0bd7f79bb68442c78c494843cdab4870224.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/6e6b8c610de871b2c8720c940421d3538cef8953.png

notes.title: Autumn Mid Season Update NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/99ea1efcc9600606736d9198765f5681cf5410ad.png
The leaves have fallen, browned by Autumn chills and shortened days, the season’s changes in full effect and that's no different for Battalion 1944.
Quelling the Infection and 50% OFF SaleOur Halloween game mode acted as the faux beginning to our MSU (Mid Season Update) as we looked to focus more on content and improving the ‘casual’ experience for new players and existing community. Since Infection’s launch last week, we have received a tremendous amount of feedback from those of you to have braved the undead plague. Over the last few days we’ve been adding new maps to keep the mode fresh moving forward (Having added Liberation, Vanguard, Coastal and today Derailed!) before its removal from our event queue tomorrow alongside the ending of our 50% OFF Halloween Sale. Many an undead scourge has met their unrelenting end that is the Baikal double barreled shotgun. Many a daring soldier has joined the tainted forces of the Infected having fallen first in combat. For those of you that missed out, do not worry. Your own personal Infection is ready to break out across the Community Server Browser as the mode will now be hostable for all those that wish to do so. With many maps still to try, we look forward to seeing how you utilise the environment to your advantage! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/d5c1dbd6ee0aabcd0cf2f8536924e63b3ebb22bc.png

New Player New UsAccessibility is key and the new player experience can be a daunting foothold to undertake for a game with a competitive nature. Due to this we’re adding new training modes to make that crossover easier for those joining us for the first time. Learning nades or smokes can be a time consuming yet rewarding experience but we can’t expect you to learn on the job. We’ve now included an easily accessible ‘Grenade Training’ mode which will grant you a full selection of maps, more nades than mouse clicks and a helpful follow function that enables you to see just how good your throwing arm is. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/7990d7470cb85df52a38e897b7470b7b34b01a80.gif

Alongside our Grenade Training is a new ‘VS Bots’ mode. Learning maps, positions, weapons and everything in between at your own pace is now a one way ticket to getting the edge on the enemy. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/05b0a699835e7c35290e491a028ff5465547634d.png

Improving Animation We’ve made changes to how the Trench Gun looks and feels making for a more natural, smoother and overall supreme animation. Sprinting now looks as it should as you grapple for control of those tight corners in close proximity combat and the new kick gives it a satisfying feel as you land that all important blow on the opposition. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/313d924da2914cad143223ee4a238bb808aae6cd.gif

Knife To Meet You: Part 1.5To bring the knife more inline with its counterparts we’ve added a crosshair, this is an important addition for those looking to line up grenades as we set in motion how we want to change the scape of melee combat based on feedback.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/f28b021625cb4dc072e56856c26529f2e145ffe5.png 

Taking InventoryWe’ve made some changes to the inventory system and how filters work, meaning you can find and equip skins in a much more efficient manner. A small quality of life change in our ongoing changes to how we’re looking to how players interact with the UI and vice versa. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/e0a64af574ac9a92dc598f86f606615e999ca8f8.png

240 FPS CapWe’ve increased the FPS Cap from 200 to 240 to better support the ongoing advances in monitor hardware. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/93af4d9d9545e16d53cb07ce19941f49e689df88.png

Server Browser Fixes and Community MindsetWith the server browser in mind, we’ve started to address issues some of you have had whilst implementing small quality of life changes to improve your journey into a community led environment. Community plays a stand out foundation for Battalion 1944 so for us these changes are an important starting point for how we can better evolve overall. 

Our first quality of life improvement and sort after tool is the ‘Favourite’ feature. You can now click the helpful star icon next to the servers ping and these servers will continue to stay at the top of your Server Browser come rain or shine. Finding your go to servers has never been easier! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/0b5d4e13377f5dd737b9e12aa868483423afd2c3.png

Another server browser issue we’re looking to tackle is the correct ping being displayed within the browser itself. Below you can find a quick and helpful guide from our man in the cloud James Tatum as to why custom servers may show their current values and how to combat that issue if you’re a server host.
When setting up a server, the "QueryPort" in the launch command should always be the "Port" number + 3. For example, if your "Port" is set as 7777, your "QueryPort" should be 7780. If this is not the case, ping will always be shown as either 999 or 0. If this IS the case and your ping is still showing as either 999 or 0, it means that steam cannot ping your server. This is likely due to a firewall or port forwarding issue.
With a focus on the community we’ll also be looking to start an ongoing ‘Community Highlight’, we’ll be talking to those that create custom maps and the likes with ways for players to try and test them in an environment for all to enjoy. This will be starting in the near future so if you’ve got a map you’d like to show off, feel free to reach out to us on our Discord! 

Bliztkrieg Battle and LadderHosted by The Plays, the Blitzkrieg Battles will once again feature every Sunday until December 1st. Enter via their FACEIT hub for your chance to win $/€250 every week in both our North American and European regions! Also coming is their new 5v5 ladder in cooperation with Mogul.gg for more nostalgia led system that will have you competing with Battalion's best and brightest! 

https://www.faceit.com/en/organizers/6cdde2da-1cea-46c3-9957-dd337fa18686/The%20Plays

https://mogul.gg/tournaments/details/22281/5v5-battalion-1944-ladder-by-the-plays

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/f4c7e93558c64d851cfe9a7047daa2b0af84621a.png

Have a great weekend! 
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: Autumn Season Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/29e3517769e5d540ea84d7f0c00298a0f8270528.png
With the Free Weekend announcement well under way, what better time for our Autumn Season Update to hit the ground running! 

The Autumn Season Update is the second seasonal update in Battalion 1944's road map since release as part of our ongoing support to improve the games, and our players overall experience. This month is no different as we look to change the dynamic of the playing field whilst maintaining the competitive integrity of the game! How do we do this you ask, well lets get into it.

Knife To Meet You!Knives in Battalion 1944 can now be fully equipped. Using a third weapon slot, taking the law into your own hands has never been easier. Pre-match knife rounds feel more rounded, movement is aesthetically improved and using Mouse 2 will silently walk you out of any sticky situation much like the pistol. We felt with the inclusion of new knife skins in our Summer Update, it was only fair for players to inspect their new armaments in the same fashion as their counterparts - but why stop at an inspect? Each knife has its own equip animation giving what we feel is a more pleasing to the eye experience. Knives currently play a primarily cosmetic role but this doesn't mean we won't be monitoring feedback moving forward!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/86ff62a57e9c230df2872f9236e2467a303dda0f.gif
For those of you with configs set in stone, we suggest rebinding the following to pave the way for your new weapon. 
 Primary Quick Switch 1
 Secondary Quick Switch 2
 Melee Quick Switch 3
 Next Weapon Mouse Wheel Down
 Previous Weapon Mouse Wheel Up

Invasion Persuasion
After Invasion's week long testing during our Special Event stage we are pleased to announce that the map will be making a full time return to our Arcade and Competitive game modes! Invasion has come a long way and now we get to see how our community really put it through its paces in the competitive environment. A lot of positions that were utilised during previous stages have been fixed to keep the balance of play but we recognise the importance and celebration of team creativity so are interested to see what you guys find next! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/fd28086495a6943a97d15e1f6e6d71c930e6b613.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/dfe7c81e873e2bd1f18aeb9b994abd951eb420cf.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/ecfd61ce09fbaa6227efdb0449279531e0f7bf27.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/2099435ac03e8e5e04d999a41340d72d1268d3ea.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/a22a04002cb17ebb2e6abf8caecfc81e295c6948.jpg

The next map to receive the rework treatment will be Savoia which will be entering the fray during Autumn's Mid Season Update in our attempt to flesh out a well received pool of maps the community can be proud of. For those of you that want to get involved with future development then look no further than our discord and social channels for Live Stream announcements with Brammer! 

Map Call Outs AddedCommunication is key in the line of duty, a foot put wrong in the line of fire means comms can hit a breaking point. One way we've set out to help new players are map call outs found underneath the Minimap. If you've ever been unsure of where you're at, worry no longer. 

The Red Sun UpgradeSupport Battalion's ongoing development this month as we take inspiration from the Pacific Theatre of War. The Red Sun Upgrade Pack is a limited time release which will be in stores until Monday 7th October. 

Every purchase contributes directly to Battalion’s ongoing development. The Red Sun Upgrade contains x10 Red Sun Warchest and the NEW M1 Garand | Wrapped! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/588ba63a38490603ea64faed41881e283c3265ed.gif

These Seasonal Upgrades pave a way for us to aim higher. Starting on October 3rd at 6pm BST in collaboration with our Free Weekend, you can grab this upgrade with a 33% discount as well as the 50% discount for our full game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/1eb5eab8bae7bf49f41be7b4770a5adf3a2ac342.png 
The Red Sun Warchest The Red Sun Warchest takes inspiration from the far East providing a multitude of new skins for an array of weapons within Battalion 1944. Tucked away deep inside is another new knife for you to flip, shank and shake around in the trenches. Why float like a butterfly when you could sting like one? Introducing, the Butterfly Knife. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/cecb31efa1b555844f1c03258ff2d1b1412fd1a4.png

There are three ways to get these skins: 

[olist]
 You can purchase them in-game by clicking 'Buy War Chests' 
 Buy 'The Red Sun DLC' on Steam and you'll receive 10 Red Sun Chests AND the Wrapped M1 Garand.
 By hitting rank 100 in Season 6 of BattleRank, every rank after 100 will drop 1 Red Sun Warchest!
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/ce359a69433f691eef5b7b565b4d95bb99205af7.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/2a93ce67eb45675e12b103c172ec062733a6d333.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/d5b4d50a147a71fbb441810a1755cec6b0d122c2.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/bf5cca69b630bb652812b57cf1c1eede213a640b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/83b72d7cf2e6085afbda71682c35955ecb4854db.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/cc032e6c08d105079fc1dd1e40f2906b724689a2.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/a850060763a2612467dfa724ec16505009dcd916.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/1357d3b489a71816706bc4e2046859c9613e3404.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/6386ed36f7155b45615e8b0200d36510408ccc82.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/5667c4bf90adee1c1d7c67cd9e4670e4ca56630d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/1d449172791539839aadcbf83381550d739357a1.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/9c4ad30ea89d331a89c1f20c409a836a0deaf145.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/ec570ea2ad422edfe67a381556b3702d6082f265.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/98018ac5f556664cd57e54d027f9d466c22f2733.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/3d772dda01c7f149e6fdee3e2f557f0dcf861ddf.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/bafbaaea7a874169d83134d163db724f256d824a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/593a74d6141b90916bd1c8e580af03280c25b50c.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/b599817677c48bbfdec27e1b4c30e3dd62b14d9e.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/cefc765515fb09bab4873254e44e76029462d2c9.png

BattleRank Season 6! - What's Coming Up?Season 6 is an exciting time for Battalion 1944, giving way to our first Free Weekend, a possible opportunity for new players and minds alike to join us in our endeavours. With that comes the Mid Season Update expected in approximately one month (or sooner) to tie in a whole new trick of changes and treat of festivities. notes.title: Unranked Wartide & Double XP Weekend - Hotfix 23896
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/bab53f4bb4bc78adebd8ea75f8eadff916ccaffd.png
Over the last five days since the release of the Mid Season Update we've been working hard to fix any and all small issues we've encountered on the way. Whilst doing so our community have been testing Invasion in our Special Event and the response has been fantastic. Using your critical feedback we can take finalise changes to Invasion making it a map we'll no doubt see in the competitive and casual map pools sooner, rather than later! For all those that have played we would just like to say thank you. But that's not all...

Unranked Wartide 
Making its return to the Battalion 1944 forefront comes Unranked Wartide. For those not in the know, Wartide is Battalion 1944's 5v5 competitive game mode - two teams face off in a 24 round showdown of attack and defence. Destroy the Axis objectives as the Allied team, whilst both factions try to outwit and outmanoeuvre each other in a game of skill and momentum. 13 rounds will take the map, baring in mind that with every round comes one life, one chance to make that game saving play, one opportunity that could make or break your teams progress.

Unranked Wartide will act as the bridging gap between our casual and competitive experience for those looking to try their hand at something different without the pressure of an ELO driven environment. Integrating this is an important choice for us and now we've various quality of life issues addressed we're glad to bring it into its own playlist! 

Maps Featured

 Liberations
 Manorhouse v2
 Coastal
 Derailed
 Vanguard

Double XP Weekend
With the addition of Unranked Wartide and in line with our recent changes to how XP works, we thought "what better time to give our wonderful community a Double XP weekend" - The time is now! Over the coming weekend and with the start of FACEIT's new season having recently begun, all XP across all of our game modes is now doubled for your Battlerank grind! 

Other Patch Notes 
 Changes to smoke to fix post processing volume issues being offset from smoke effect


We're making an ever lasting effort to support the Battalion 1944 community by addressing many issues big and small, keep an eye out for future updates and keep your fantastic feedback coming in! 

Have a great weekend

notes.title: Mid Season Update LIVE! - Casual, Invasion and Smoke Reworks
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/d037e2e316f3f979212b59d66049928264db109a.png

Four weeks have passed since the release of our first Seasonal patch in our concentrated effort to supporting Battalion 1944 long term. Mid Season has arrived, and we’re excited to show you what we have instore! Let's get started.  

The Bulk(head) Of It - The Casual Experience Over the last few weeks we’ve been keeping you guys informed with previews and developer streams as a way to better gauge what our players want most. We recognise the value in our player’s ongoing commitment which help us maintain and mould Battalion 1944 across the board. With an increased attentiveness to casual gameplay we’re really able to hone in on what make our mechanics fun to utilise in said environment as we move forward.

We’ve improved the experience ten fold by revisiting the way our players interact with game modes and each other. In previous versions of Battalion 1944 and for many of our casual community, ‘Arcade’ felt somewhat lacklustre, something we have never disagreed with, a spare part in a much bigger machine but one we intend on re-inventing as we proceed. By re-adding modes that you loved from day one to those requested across multiple avenues you can be sure we have something for you in Battalion 1944. 

Free For AllOne hotly requested game mode has been Free For All, the ultimate be your own hero shoot em up experience. Think you’re capable of doing all the heavy lifting? Now it's time to put it to the test. Up to 12 players face off in the ultimate rumble, selecting their choice of weaponry as you fight to the top of the scoreboard. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/116626e3bd9b60f2166efaa862be900034e5db79.jpg

Rifles OnlyYou read that right, with free for all comes the ever loved 1 pop till you drop fanfare. A slew of wiggles and weaves as you land the perfect shot or keep up the momentum as you make your way through the server decimating everything in your path. A classic game mode we’re excited to include in our Arcade rotation full time. As we'll be including it in the main arcade queue this means we’ll see the inclusion of the M1 Garand. We understand how this may frustrate the rifles only purists amongst us, but it's important to give players the ability to learn how to counter the bolt-action rifles with the Garand as well as allowing some players who are now voted into a rifles only game to have an alternate option with a gun that is ultimately- still a rifle.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/b120f397909ab5114432ad356a39c1930a331bcb.jpg

Arcade Map and Mode VotingWith the inclusion of the aforementioned game modes and full time positioning of HQ we have introduced map and game mode voting as a mainstay for the Arcade queue. We firmly believe that our community should get to decide how they experience the game in a casual environment and we’re now glad to give you the option. Whether it be Free for All Rifles Only on Manorhouse or Domination on Liberation. The choice is now yours. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/1311491e8a8acb3b7a9b00f38717518a69eedf0f.jpg
A selection of 6 mix and match of maps and modes awaits you on the vote screen.

Test The New Invasion!Map reworks are a common trend and balance is no laughing matter. For us at Bulkhead we want our maps to be the best they can and over the last month, a lot of our community have been sitting down with Brammer every week to have their say on Invasion’s facelift and rework. We’re glad that in this time we’ve seen a diverse change to the way YOUR map plays overall and can’t wait to see how it plays in both casual and competitive environments. Check out some of the changes below!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/d43abebd2082c23785bbaa9018fc1606a14a95f1.jpg
A substantial rework to Mid opens up the map for multiple attack points

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/6d0582a0b7bc3e96dd74d9d2db62063b2e3517c2.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/9538db77239ee6fabf9120af8face3c2afafe626.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/59a3bd7bc7e9375ca431d96fa8377a6eca238d8d.jpg
Attack the new and improved A site via the concrete luge of Yellow

Now that you’ve had a taste of what's to come, why not try it for yourself? For the next week, Unranked Wartide on Invasion will feature as our Special Event - in this time we await patiently for your valuable feedback on what you think does or does not work, so go forth our merry community and test, test, test! 

Possible inclusion of casual wartide coming? 

Smoke OverhaulAs previously shown in a recent Mid Season Preview we introduced you to Battalion 1944’s new smoke grenade. 

Smoke grenades play a huge part in Battalion’s break away defence and first line of attack. They provide the foundation for key, round winning moments, or block crucial information to prevent an opponent's advances.

Over the last year we’ve constantly been working towards balancing and creating a formidable smoke. A smoke that does exactly what it says on the tin, and dare I say, we think we’re pretty close. We’ve improved the smoke so that players will no longer be able to turn the edge of the smoke client side using their mouse as a way to gain an advantage. You can see the difference below!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/a289f5f1ab15808b59ef581e0a61a14bedc293ae.jpg
Old Smoke

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/cd008c68890eed9d17f69abce9180736ae7ce818.jpg
New Smoke

Our man in the cloud (of smoke) James Tatum gave us a run down of exactly how the smokes in Battalion work, give it a read here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/489940/announcements/detail/1617276469910067569

UI and Quality of Life ChangesWe recently spoke of quality of life and how it helps us evolve in a way that benefits the general feel, mentality and future of the game. This week you’ll see some of these changes come into full effect, quite literally. We’ve adjusted the main menu to give it a feeling of home by condensing the vital information you guys want to see. We’ll always be looking to add to our UI in a way that fits the ongoing evolution of Battalion 1944.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/785e33f2112f79753b361eb8d4e3106c6ec6ecb4.jpg
Other quality of life issues we've included are

 STG & BAR hipfire changes to buff Thompson & MP40
 Shotgun rack time decrease 
 VOIP now visible in buy menu to improve pre-round communication
 Request Donation button added 
 Improved hit registration & client side bullet collision effects
 Removed medals from bot kills
 Option to delete items from inventory


Battalion 1944 @ epic.LAN - Powered by Chillblast
For us at Bulkhead and many of those within Battalion's competitive scene, epic.LAN has been a right of passage providing an affordable and more community-driven event within the UK - an ethos we too believe in. Taking your first steps at a grass roots level should be open to all and with the help from our friends at Chillblast (who have kindly provided 40 turn up and play machines) that idea has become a reality. Up to as many of 32 teams will face off at the Kettering Conference Centre for their share of up to £15,000 on October 10th - 13th. 

Want to know more? Check out: https://www.epiclan.co.uk/ for signup information! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/a02830330089a5116590597fdbdf23eaad4c4fab.png

Year One Roadmap
Whether you're joining us for the very first time or a returning player, remember to check out our Year One Roadmap. Packed full of free content and fixes, looking to keep you up to date which just what we're looking to add to Battalion 1944's future. We hope you join us for the long haul as we look to commit to the games ongoing development! 

https://steamcommunity.com/games/489940/announcements/detail/2709396928711893740

Have a great week! 
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/ccf14a822a7e6cd0f6f31d42439789bbd7fe22ad.png

Summer Season Update
Hey all! We’re thrilled to be taking the first step in our long term support of Battalion 1944, starting with our first seasonal update that launches RIGHT NOW!

We’re calling this release the ‘Summer Season Update’.

This season will run for 2 months (along with a mid season balance update half way through!) and come with a whole host of community requests features and tweaks! 

NEW Gamemode: Headquarters

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/d2f72e0d0fbc693a99f3d9119b314a7941b8939d.jpg
Our new casual gamemode 'Headquarters' is great fun for all types of players. In this mode, teams must capture and hold a set point (HQ) that is randomly spawned in the map.. The longer it is held, the more points that team gains.  However, the team that holds the headquarters only has 1 life each until the objective is either successfully defended or overrun by the ever respawning enemies! 

The best HQ players will coordinate with their team to enforce an ironclad defensive perimeter around a captured headquarters in order to hold it. We can’t wait to see how players find ways to master this new fun gamemode!

The Gladiator Upgrade

Support Battalion’s ongoing development and invoke the strength and ruthlessness of Roman
Gladiators by adorning your weaponry with the markings of these ancient warriors.

The Gladiator’s Upgrade Pack is a limited time release which will be in stores until X Date.
Every purchase contributes directly to Battalion’s ongoing development. The Gladiator’s
Upgrade contains:

One Exclusive NEW Supporters Knife
Ten NEW Gladiator War Chests
The Battalion 1944 Digital Soundtrack

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/a0f0ac574b4a7e459603d5a0286ee2611fbcc815.png

Players have been asking for a way to support Battalion 1944’s ongoing development costs - so as a reward for those who choose to help the future of Battalion as a franchise we’re giving everyone who picks up The Gladiators Upgrade will receive a brand new and exclusive ‘supporters’ knife with an inscription highlighting them as Battalion 1944 supporter.
We thank you all for your continued support and look forward to bringing many more updates to Battalion 1944!

You can purchase The Gladiators Upgrade on Steam for 33% off this week here.

The Gladiator War Chest
The Gladiators Warchest contains one skin for every primary weapon currently in the game, all themed around the Romans. Also hidden away deep within this regal chest is an incredibly rare item, the first ever knife added to Battalion 1944… The Gladiator Knife!

b713862daffd922c5a94799ce235d7dbcefe.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/cd0060bb6aaf49bc317fb35686baa7b6bcfc9505.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/76f71a0c0c96b99fd2900f9f31255040412157c7.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/c582b832b8c69f3638b7a7acc80336776b43917f.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/f0ef478703055fb7c39657f2bf0a7c67472e9038.png

Rework of Competitive Maps

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/dd54d83a0f37e96c2f3485bbbdf20d393b85fd7d.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/5ffb67b4e42cc6984a6711b9f2f2b318e87db1a7.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/5f837be6e1fd85561933aabb7c1c029276e10d54.jpg
Map design is a clear area for improvement in Battalion 1944. That's why we'll be pulling Invasion, Docks, and Savoia from the competitive pool for Season 5. We will gradually reintroduce these maps, beginning with Invasion, which is aimed to be tested in our first mid season patch in one months time. We will heavily be involving the community in the map design process. Invasion's rework is being streamed regularly on our lead dev Brammertron's twitch channel.

Patch Notes

Competitive Patch Notes

Tactical Timeout added to Wartide (30 Seconds) (1 per half)
Technical Timeout added to Wartide (60 Seconds) (1 per match)
M1 Carbine firing animation/ironsight lineup fixed
[code]Carbine firing animation now lines up correctly with the actual bullet direction[/code]
Invasion pulled from competitive map rotation for rework
Savoia pulled from competitive map rotation for rework
Docks pulled from competitive map rotation for rework
Wartide Max Tokens changed from 12 > 14 
[code]Players should feel slightly less risk when buying a sniper and full nades now - as well as allowing SMG players to bank more tokens to donate to their scope player.[/code]
Thompson Range Nerf
MP40 Range Nerf
MP28 & Grease Gun Range Nerf
M1 Garand buff & cost in Wartide changed from 3 tokens to 4.
[code]Rate of fire increased by 4%[/code]
BAR cost in Wartide changed from 4 tokens to 3. 



Other Patch Notes

Headquarters mode added as Special Event
Health Feedback Overhauled (Blood Visuals & Sound Queues) 
Health Regen Functionality & Speed Increase
[code]Now, when taking over 70 damage player will enter ‘critical’ status. The critical status is indicated to the player through new audio queues and increased intensity in the blood effects on screen. The player will not regenerate any health for ‘5 seconds’. After the freeze period is over, the player will regenerate to 100% health in ‘1 second’. The player will know when they have fully regenerated by the ‘relaxed breath’ sound queue.[/code]
Skins now save and transfer between rounds
[code]If you pick up a weapon off the ground, the skin will transfer between rounds until you die or pick up a different weapon[/code]
General sound fixes & audio improvements
[code]SVT reskinned to allow bullet movement for the fire anim so bullet gets chambered[/code]
PPS43 fire animation improved
Added inventory item duplicate number
[code]To show how many duplicates of one item you have in your inventory[/code]
Chat overlay background is now always visible
[code]This is to improve chat visibility on brighter maps[/code]
Minimap zoom out amount increased
Improved performance and visuals on water shaders
Knives added to game as item (inspects coming next season)



Bug Fixes


Fixed fog/smoke bug
[code]There was a bug where players who had fog enabled could see the outline of other players in smoke on some maps. This has been fixed for Vanguard, Manorhouse, and Liberation. Please let us know if you have visual evidence of it happening on other maps[/code]
SVT animation fixes
Fixed some Coastal visibility collision issues
Play and Day streaks now showing correct values
Fixed Vanguard see through walls / collision issues
STG shot skipping bug fixed
BAR sprint interpolation animation bug fixed
Kar98 hipfire wrist animation clipping fixed
M1 Carbine left handed arm/clipping issue on animation
Fixed some locations where guns cannot be picked up on Liberation
Improved BAR idle animation and fixed wrist clipping
Fixed BattleRank skins not granting (any issues please use discord)
Fixed blood visual effect not resetting on spawn 
Fixed 'haybale' collision
Various collision fixes
BAR vault animation bug fixed





What's next?

Community Manager Starting Next Week!
Next week our community manager will be joining us and getting into the nitty gritty parts of the community! But don't worry, we want to keep a really strong connection between the devs and the players.

Summer Mid Season Update
The mid season patch gives us an opportunity to change any meta and balancing issues. It also allows us to test out a new map rework. On September 2nd 2019, we will push a game update that amongst other things will contain the ‘new rework’ for Invasion. The map will not be added to the competitive pool straight away but it will enter Unranked 5v5 in the Special Event queue. The idea is that this gives the community a whole month to test out our rework of Invasion and let us know what changes need to be made. Then, when the Autumn Season Update lands at the start of October, we will push the final version live to the game and Invasion will be re-added to the official competitive circuit (FACEIT). We believe this is the best way for us to improve one of our biggest issues, map design. Actively working with the community to solve their issues.

Autumn Season (Season 6)
The Autumn will begin in the first week of October 2019. this does not mean that we won't be updating the game.

One Year Roadmap

https://steamcommunity.com/games/489940/announcements/detail/2709396928711893740

If you're wondering which direction we're looking to take Battalion, look no further. Last week we revealed our one year content plan for Battalion 1944.
You can read that update here.

Thanks,
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: Official Post Release Roadmap - Coming Soon
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/1d6402df67ca8bdd9452bb8fcc7b4102af7239f0.png

Battalion 1944’s launch was a huge success.

Success we knew the game had the potential to have - but couldn’t quite believe ourselves when it started to happen. We have smashed sales expectations, smashed player count expectations (1000 peak was the dream) and recently raised our review score from Mostly Negative to Very Positive. This was done through hard work and absolute support from our community. However - there’s one question that’s on everyone’s lips.

“What’s next?”

We’re doubling down on Battalion 1944. This success has meant ‘post release’ plans have taken a little longer than we would have wanted to spin up, prepare and announce. However, with our belief in this project we’re reinvesting back into Battalion to turn this IP into a long term top tier FPS.

We know Battalion 1944 can be better.
We know the game isn’t perfect.
We echo the same wants & needs as you because we are players too!

We’re a growing independant studio. We have made mistakes, we wear our hearts on our sleeves and we respond as earnestly and honestly as we can about development to our players because this game is something more than just another FPS - Battalion 1944 is the last remaining chance we have as gamers to keep the raw thrill of a skilled and competitive fast paced FPS relevant within this rapidly changing landscape. 

Our publishing friends at Square Enix Collective understands that significance and will be helping us support this community every step of the way. Battalion 1944’s success has sent a message that this style of FPS is something that can thrive within the modern era - and with love, polish, time & your continued support over the next few years - we can take Battalion to where we aim it to be in the long term.

In the short term however - some players want more content, some players want map redesigns, some players want overall polish and stability, some players want the competitive scene to grow with leagues and tournaments to play for...

We have a plan to deliver on ALL of those wishes. 

We’ve been reading every single piece of feedback since launch and have worked to create a roadmap with a bunch of new content, gamemodes, polish and fixes that address all of these concerns.

This is why we’ll be releasing a development roadmap very soon - prior to the launch of BattleRank Season 5!

We’ve doubled down our investment into Battalion 1944 by expanding our development team significantly purely for this post release content and we can’t wait to share our plans with you.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/15885898babb566c35834f1cbc286b0049f98564.png

Focusing on the Big Picture - New & Casual Player Experience
The goal with the upcoming roadmap is not to be worrying about, or trying to force, the player base to grow too early - it's about making Battalion 1944 a better game throughout the next year, so that when we do free weekends and sales and new players flood back into the game at key points - they get an even better experience than the update before.

Every single update we’re going to be focusing on improving that new player & casual player experience, which coincidently will mean huge quality of life improvements for existing hardcore players. This will mean more content, more players and more polish based on your feedback. Making sure players feel like they can transition from new players, to casual players, to competitive players and eventually beginning their path to pro is very important to us. This means helping new players get to grips with the game is our number one priority and focus with new features and development.

It will take time to shape Battalion 1944 into this ideal package, meaning we need our existing playerbase to have faith and commit to playing through the lulls to keep Battalion 1944 healthy and strong. That way, when we arrive at those key dates and we market & push the game infront of new players, they want to stick around and continue to help grow Battalion 1944.

Competitive Roadmap Begins
Battalion 1944 managed to capture the hopes and dreams of young and veteran FPS lovers worldwide. We will be growing the competitive side of the game at the same rate as Battalion’s potential, which will grow ever bigger as development & support continues for years to come.
We’re currently in the process of organising Battalion’s competitive future. But it’s important that our players know that we aren’t just blindly throwing six figure prize pools at tournaments in the next two months when the game isn’t ready.

We’re under no illusions that Battalion as a brand has a way to go before it can enter the top tier of FPS titles that we intend it to eventually become. This doesn’t mean that we aren’t intending to support our competitive player base until those days inevitably arrive in 5/10 years time. In the meantime - we want Battalion 1944 to provide that dream for our new & dedicated players - the path for anyone to become a professional gamer.

This is why we’re happy to announce today the first step in our three tiered plan for competitive play...

Announcing The Blitzkrieg League


The first phase of our Tournament Roadmap begins with the Summer Season Update...
Ran and organised by our friends over at The Plays, we want to introduce players to our competitive league format with some nice prize pool bonuses for playing.

Official Website of Blitzkrieg Summer:
https://theplays.gg/blitzkrieg-summer/

The first step towards your path to pro begins in the Blitzkrieg Open League.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/560b22e35ecdc67dd99a65bc0e50f6ea1113656c.png

Open League - Open to everyone. At the end of the season the four best teams will progress into the playoffs with   their share of prize pool and a chance to qualify for the premier division. The “Relegation” cup at the end of the season will be the one and only way to qualify for the premier division.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/1d6402df67ca8bdd9452bb8fcc7b4102af7239f0.png

Everyone has the opportunity to graduate from the Open Division into the premier division.

Premier League - 2 groups, each group has 6 teams. Top 4 teams will be going into playoffs. The top 6 teams will get their share of the prize pool depending on their placement in playoffs. The last team of each group will go into the “relegation cup” against the top 4 teams of Open League and they will fight for their spot in the premier division.

The qualification method for the Season 1 of the Premier Division positions are still being decided. Follow @ThePlaysGG on twitter for up to date information.

Summer 2019 Season Prizing

Open
Start: August 1st 2019
End: October 6th 2019
Total Prizing: $3,000

2nd Place: $750
3rd Place: $500
4th Place: $250

5th Place: $250
6th Place: $250

With this commitment to growth from us at Bulkhead with the backing of Square Enix its a no brainer for anyone wanting to follow the dream and invest your time for the long term. As you’re reading this the competition is already starting to practice - what are you waiting for?

Grab your mates & sign up to the Open League next week right here: https://theplays.gg/blitzkrieg-summer/ 


Hiring Full Time Community Manager
We’ve been working insanely hard on plans and development, meaning we’ve almost been too busy to communicate directly with our players as much as we would like. We’re happy to announce we have hired a community manager to help connect our playerbase to us as developers with the regular communication you deserve across Steam, Discord and Reddit. 

The person we’ve hired is a well known figure within our own community who will help us structure and grow our game based on your feedback and concerns.

Our Community Manager starts bright and early on the 5th August 2019 - and we can’t wait to introduce you to them!


Closing Comments
We’re on this journey with you as players like no other studio before us. We’ve shown time and time again that we eventually  deliver on what the community wants from us when given the time & patience that’s needed with a smaller game development studio. We’re asking you to believe in us once again and to keep playing the game as we lead up to previewing our content plans every month.

The first seasonal update - The Summer Update drops August 1st.

Excited? We’ll be previewing the content in this update later this month… stay tuned to our Official Twitter, Discord and Steam news to stay in the loop with everything you need to know.

For now - We’ll be on the servers this weekend playing with you guys.

Play Battalion 1944 Competitive this weekend and receive a FREE War Chest!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/f12430fff1f9f481f3894349564bd5cccf49cfb0.png

This weekend, earn 1 Red Star War Chest for playing five matches of Battalion 1944 on Faceit!
The Mission will be live on Faceit from 5PM BST today, Friday 12th, and run throughout the weekend!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/364f1b1c04fdf642ac3f05908d941d33c2a45d25.png

Grab your friends, boot up Battalion 1944 and strap in for a load of post release content starting with our upcoming roadmap announcement. Today is just the beginning.

Thanks
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: Patch 23011 - BattleRank Season 4, Unranked Wartide & Shotgun Nerf LIVE!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/2392583092aec929177a9986b9d4a61f323d6eda.jpg

Hey all! 

Patch 23011 is now LIVE!
The entire server update process could take up to 2 hours of downtime.
See you on the other side!

Here's what is in this season's update:

Special Event - Unranked Wartide Trial

We’ve heard your requests for a casual Wartide queue. To replace the shotgun sendoff special event, we’re trialing an unranked version of Wartide in its place. It's important for players to understand that we need to be careful when implementing new playlists, as it further splits the playerbase between matchmaking queues - which could end up detrimental to the Battalion 1944 experience long term. We’ll be watching player distribution carefully to make a clear & informed decision on the queues permanence at a later date.

Another reason for this trial is to test for issues and bugs related to bots within Wartide. We would like to introduce bots to Faceit competitive play to alleviate the impact of leavers (allowing you to take control of a bot after you die if a teammate has left). However we want to use this trial to identify bugs and issues that can be fixed using the casual unranked setting before rolling out this change to competitive play.

However, we fully understand the desire for a fun & relaxed version of the gamemode that’s casual enough to enjoy without the pressures of ranked play. 

We were concerned with 5v5 being too intense for new players. Hopefully with this playlist and its increased 10v10 player count, we can encourage new players to transition from arcade and learn the basic rules of Wartide, including map layouts and mechanics before queueing into competitive play. 10v10 will alleviate the pressure for inexperienced players with more players to kill and less focus on their individual play. Experienced players on the other hand will be able to take a break from competitive, frag out like it's arcade and indirectly show new players who are spectating tips, tricks and how to play in clutch situations.

Unranked Wartide Rules

10v10.
MR6.
Knife Round Enabled.
Overtime Enabled (MR3)
Bots Enabled (Testing)
Lower match completion bonus than competitive play.


We’ll be watching how this plays out and looking in #bug_reports on the official Discord to see what issues arise!

Wartide XP Bonus

To balance out the XP gain between Wartide & Arcade playlists - we’re raising the match bonus reward for completing a match of Wartide to make sure your time is rewarded correctly!

BattleRank Season 4

With the end of a season comes a new one!
Exactly like last season - reach level 50 and you get the animated skin!

BattleRank Season 4 is now LIVE!


Bronze Level 1 	|	MP28 - Green Camo
Bronze Level 5 	|	Grease Gun - Ivory Three
Silver Level 10	|	STG44 - Friend of Jack
Silver Level 15  	|	Kar98k - Grizzly Hunter
Gold Level 20 	|	M1 Garand - Deathbringer
Gold Level 25 	| 	M1 Garand - Ivory Seven
Platinum Level 30 	|	MP40 - Wings	
Platinum Level 35 	| 	M1 Carbine - Ivory Six
Emerald Level 40 	| 	STG44 - Ivory Eight
Emerald Level 45 	| 	Thompson | Stealth Flawless	
Diamond Level 50+ | 	Shotgun - Lionheart (ANIMATED)


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/e868b544002439e84c03a2cf6b70fc346180d8a7.png

Season 4 and its rewards were planned in advance and will function the same as the Season 3 - however next season we’ve got some new updates coming to the BattleRank implementation for more rewards simply for playing!

Shotgun Balance Changes

BattleRank Season 3’s most effective weapon has been brought back to earth for Season 4.
 A combination of changes have made the weapon effective at close ranges only - making the weapon much less of a threat overall.

Due to community feedback and the obvious power of the shotguns they have been altered to become situational weapons that are intended to be played in close quarters ranges and off angles rather than an ‘all round’ weapon choice. This means there will be positions where the cheap 2 coin shotgun will have its place to allow you to surprise and pick off unprepared players and take their weapon as your own.

Shotgun Maximum Range Heavily Reduced
The longest possible range of the shotgun has been heavily reduced from 4096 units to 1536 units - meaning all shotgun pellets now become entirely ineffective after the 1536 unit range. This will stop players being able to finish off low health players with the shotgun at long range. Players will need to learn this new effective distance before taking shots that previously would have connected.

Damage has been slightly increased at very close range (within 512 units) - meaning only 3/8 pellets must hit the enemy to get a one shot kill.

At its new longest possible range (1536 units) - all pellets need to hit a target to get a 1 shot kill. In the majority of cases you’ll need to fire 2-3 pumps at this distance to hit enough pellets for a kill.

Between these new minimum and maximum ranges of 512 & 1536 units, damage will fall off the further away you are from the target.

Shotgun Crosshair & Spread Accurately Represented

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/1f52d0e502bab970a8019488c8ec98af02065f5c.jpg

Its very important to remember that shotgun damage is based on how many pellets connect with the target. The closer you are the tighter the spread! There is no RNG on where the pellets will land - it’s purely based on centering your aim over the player & making sure the pellets connect.

However - to help with communication we’ve decided to bring in the spread of the crosshair to more accurately portray where pellets will land - this will hopefully reduce the frustrating moments where a player at close range who has only part of their crosshair over the enemy misses due to none of the pellets connecting.

BAR Balance Changes

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/61bb029ffc8386dfd08194bce25885bbda6c60ad.jpg
New BAR Ironsight to match the STG44


BAR now has 30 rounds instead of 20
BAR weapon reload sway reduced by 60%
New audio for firing
Cost increased from 3 > 4 Tokens


M1 Garand Changes

Cost Reduced from 4 > 3 Tokens


Knife Changes

To reduce the viability of ‘prone knifing’ we have reduced the reach of the knife when in any stance that isn’t standing, meaning you’ll have to be closer to the enemy to get a kill when in crouch or prone stance.


Standing has the furthest reach.
Crouching knifing has slightly less reach than standing
Prone knifing has significantly less reach than crouching


Map Changes
- Docks now has a wall to prevent allies sniping directly into the Axis spawn church

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/4472a2c94cb6607ac5bd832b4e8d6400a14e3f03.jpg

Bug Fixes & Misc

 Potential fix for the ‘infinite reload’ bug (special thanks to supreme, bAAz and Tobin)
 Potential fix for disappearing arms when using left handed viewmodel
 Disabled all voting in FFA game modes to reduce abuse of the kick function.
 Added profanity filter to ingame chat to help reduce abusive language
 Fixed collision issues on multiple maps

notes.title: Pre-Season 4 Update - Shotgun Nerf Incoming, BattleRank Season 3 ends 1st July 2019
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/465b99a65e5e9efee3dfa0cf173dea73f02758e1.jpg

What a month it has been for Battalion 1944, coming back from the jaws of Early Access and being propelled back into the FPS spotlight. It was great to celebrate the successful release with the rivals event hosted and directed by Twitch themselves - and shows more than our own community that the potential for competitive viewership is there.

Looking forward to the end of this month, comes the end of BattleRank Season 3.

BattleRank Season 3 Officially Ends 1st July 2019
The next few days will be your last chance to reach BattleRank Level 50+ to receive your very own animated STG44 | Glow which reacts to your gameplay!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/571631020f3486536d42fc090e041a3e05481e3e.png

https://youtu.be/1CiBsm7EZjc

As many people have pointed out, the current market value of the STG44 | Glow is higher than the cost of the game. We would say that’s pretty good value for your money & time!

https://steamcommunity.com/market/listings/489940/STG44%20%7C%20Glow

Double XP Weekend!

To increase your chances of reaching level 50 before the weekend is over, we’re introducing double XP - which will run for this weekend only until the launch of BattleRank Season 4!

Weekend Special Event - Shotgun Sendoff

If there’s anything Battlerank Season 3 (Faceit Season 2) will be remembered for - it’ll be the Trenchgun meta. This weekend will be your last chance to decimate with the shotgun in its current state before they become a blast from the past… and to celebrate that we’re running a weekend only event in our limited time only queue called ‘Shotgun Sendoff’

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/167c42b713b7f75dd102e5eec2f921a3217ca227.png

This is purely a fun event for the last few days of Season 3 and will help you get those sweet experience points to level your BattleRank before Season 4 begins.

Balance Changes Coming With BattleRank Season 4

With every season we will re-evaluate the Battalion 1944 metagame if needs be. Letting the season play out has ensured that we see which weapons have the largest issues that need addressing for the following season, whilst keeping gameplay consistent for competitive & tournament play within the current season. Disruption through hotfixes should only be reserved for fixing game breaking issues & crashes (for example the endless CTF bug). 

Having more time also enables us to address the issues in a clearer way by gathering all of the feedback and addressing the correct issues rather than knee jerk responses based on individual clips. Balance will always be an ongoing process - but with Monday’s patch will come a new meta that will evolve throughout that season. We’re looking forward to seeing what strategies prevail as players become accustomed to the changes! 

July 1st’s balance changes will be detailed in Monday’s patch notes along with the client update.
But yes… the shotgun has been reworked!

Faceit - INSIGHT INTO MATCHMAKING 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/e026b6627dd36226b72f3a7914aa48cfd22a85f4.png

Talking about Wartide - The team at Faceit have put together an amazing article on how Matchmaking in Battalion 1944 works and how it could be improved over time. For anyone who’s wondering about why and how certain matchups happen - take a read over on their official site here: 

https://blog.faceit.com/insight-into-matchmaking-in-battalion-1944-f34481db45ca


Client Update & BattleRank Season 4 - Releases 1st July 2019

BattleRank Season 4 will bring a new set of skins for you to play for aswell as a client update with new content and bug fixes. We'll be sharing more details along with the release patch notes on July 1st!

Hope to see you all grinding on the servers this weekend!
- Bulkhead Interactive

notes.notes:

Hey all!

Another amazing day for Battalion 1944 yesterday, obliterating our expectations and setting our record number of concurrent players and most copies sold since full release! We’re thrilled with the support we’re receiving to bring back old school shooters - with players and streamers flocking to get their dose of the Battalion 1944 hype through word of mouth.

It's been amazing to see so many players relate to this classic style of FPS and because of this, we’ve been working hard on fixes and new quality of life features as well as bigger content behind the scenes for the future. This is only the beginning for Battalion 1944!

Free For All - Rifles Only playlist lands on Invasion
Our event playlist fittingly lands on the beaches of Normandy with Invasion being this week’s map in the playlist rotation.

Faceit Improve Party Management &  Quality of Life Features!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/35f0b23f433146f60502c5608bdbf8cca0bc1ee0.png

 SEA Servers - Coming Soon!

 Muzzle Flash - Weapon Feedback Polish

A Bright Future for Battalion 1944

notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 22676
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/dc04ed153d3c8c5fd08e38bd43c7137f2e52d903.jpg

Challenges return, pre season weapon tuning, important bug fixes and...
'Free For All - Rifles Only' playlist heads to Savoia!

Hey all!

We’re amazed! We couldn’t be more grateful to our community for helping us get Battalion 1944 to this point. To see social media flooding with comments on how Battalion 1944 has taken people back to their ‘glory days’ of gaming has been overwhelming. We simply can’t respond to all of you, but thank you for letting us know how you feel about Battalion. 

Trust us, after 3 years of hard work and highs and lows, we could not be happier with this response to the full release!

The Stats: Player Numbers & Game Growth

For the first 6 days of launch Battalion’s player count grew and grew every single day, all the way into the mid week! This exceeded everyone’s expectations. It’s pretty rare in the games industry to achieve this kind of growth after an early access launch (especially after one like ours!) so we’re confident that we’re doing the right thing and that we just need to keep going and supporting the game with updates. The most interesting stat to us, is that on the day where the player numbers growth slowed, we also sold more copies of Battalion than any other day, as well as receiving solid sustained player numbers in NA. We can only assume that the game will keep growing from here as we continue to support the game.

So... onto the news!

Fixes for Menu Stuttering & Faceit Stuttering
Some users were experiencing issues with the main menu stuttering - especially new users who had not played Battalion 1944 before or in a very long time. This is a very multifaceted bug, meaning previous fixes we’ve deployed would work for certain users but not others!

However, thanks to your reports we’ve nailed the main reasons this would occur & have deployed fixes. We’re confident in saying 99% of the main menu stuttering issues should be fixed within this update. If anyone experiences more stutters of a similar nature (game related not server) - then please post in our bug report section on the Steam discussions!

 Significantly reduced CPU usage on main menu video 

We have also reduced CPU usage in the main menus by reducing the size and impact of the main menu background video! Enjoy a much smoother experience from today!

Further Load Time Improvements
Whilst we still recommend using an SSD over outdated HDDs for players loading into maps - we have made improvements to load times on initial boot as well as small gains when loading into maps (especially the new maps Vanguard, Docks and Goldrush!) This should help players failing to connecting to a match in time before the match is automatically cancelled.

Challenges Are Back!
We did have some hiccups at launch, it’s true. But as we finish up our first week as a released game we have crushed most of the core bugs. Challenges are now once again visible to players on the Battlerank screen. You have been completing challenges the whole time you’ve been playing and receiving chests for them, this fix just allows you to see what you’ve been doing! 

Ladder Climbing Improvements
Ladders were sometimes a bit difficult to ‘climb off’ of once you reached the top. We have lowered the ‘top point’ of most of the ladders in the game in all maps.

Rebalanced XP on Medals
Some of the medals were extremely generous with XP - making it more beneficial to play Arcade over Wartide. This has been refined for a more balanced experience!

Weapon Changes & Balancing Improvements
M1 Garand
Reload time buffed from 1.8 seconds to 1.25 seconds
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fDwAs5moU_4&feature=youtu.be
MP40
Reduced headshot damage at long range
Thompson
Reduced headshot damage at long range
PPSh-41
Reduced headshot damage at long range
Damage falloff begins at a closer range than other SMGs
M1 Carbine
Extra ammo buffed from 30 > 45 (Total 60 Bullets)
Gewehr 43
Extra ammo buffed from 30 > 45 (Total 60 Bullets)
SVT-40
Extra ammo buffed from 30 > 40 (Total 50 Bullets)

TL;DR
- Chunking maps to improve initial boot load time, as well as load time into newer maps
- Changes to M1 Garand reload speed.
- Changes to SMG’s long range capabilities.
- Changes to Carbines to have more reserve ammo.
- Fixed collision issues on Liberation.
- Fixed collision issues on Coastal.
- Fixed collision issues on Vanguard.
- Updated Savoia minimap.
- Added bot points of interest (POI) on Battery, Vanguard, Docks and AimKosak.
- Re-enabled challenges.
- Fix for an exploit where if you leaned and then vaulted, your third person would no longer lean in third person but it would in first person.
- Reduced XP rewards for some arcade only medals.
- Replaced the main menu video with a lower quality version, should improve main menu performance and initial boot load time.
- Removed the ability to turn off post round audio notifications. Instead they can only be turned to a low volume level to help players know when a round has ended.
- Added a potential fix for the menu stutter seen by some players. This may also fix the looping login on the faceit competitive screen.
- Improvements to ladders on all maps.


See you in the servers!
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: Patch 22602 Notes, Load Times, Arcade & Rifles Only!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/e5adfb36ed070c59d3cd2b313e3d4a874c608b05.jpg
After a successful weekend, patch 22602 improves load times and brings back the Arcade & Rifles Only playlists!

Hey all!

Launch weekend has been amazing - we’ve seen a massive resurgence of interest in Battalion 1944, with players and streamers worldwide picking up the game and getting stuck in. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=urmR5sQccGI&feature=youtu.be

After a great first weekend, we saw the player numbers grow every day from release, this is a great sign for the longevity of the game! Whilst we completely anticipate the numbers to dip slightly or flatten out due to it now being weekdays rather than the weekend, we are thrilled that we were able to continue to grow our player base daily over this past weekend giving us the confidence we need to continue working on and improving Battalion 1944. 


A consistent daily playerbase is more important than a large influx of players who drop off - and our curve is indicating just that, as nice stable playerbase... and we haven't even done a free weekend yet! If you guys keep playing and supporting Battalion 1944 - we’ll continue to support the games growth with new content, updates and fixes.

So - onto the news!

Arcade & Special Events Queue
After the game went live on Thursday and our game was exposed to thousands we saw issues with players not being put on the same team correctly and having issues searching. Whilst the searching issues were fixed that night, the auto balance issue was still outstanding. We decided to temporarily remove Arcade and Rifles Only as queues from the game and instead directed players towards the server browser as a temporary measure to ensure players could find matches.

However, today we have officially reopened the Arcade and Special Event queue. We will run this event until Friday! When we’ll be running a different special event for the weekend, watch out this week for that announcement.

Load Time Improvements
We are aware there are issues relating to load times, particularly for players on hard drives instead of an SSD. In this patch we have made some nice improvements to the load times so you can get into games faster - however we still recommend installing the game on an SSD for now. We plan to make more load time improvements, specifically for the new maps, later in the week when we can safely test some new improvements.


Economy Sniper & Rifle Changes Wartide
As we are still in pre-season (Until May 31st) we were comfortable with making some final tweaks to this seasons economy. Although we are aware that some people believe certain weapons are overpowered, we’d like to allow a meta to properly develop in a tournament setting before we make reactive changes to the game. However, the following changes are designed to make the game more strategic for high level players whilst at the same time not punishing new players. We will be making the following changes.


Kar98k 5 Tokens > 6 Tokens
Kar98k Scoped 5 Tokens > 7 Tokens
Mosin Nagant 5 Tokens > 6 Tokens
Mosin Nagant Scoped 5 Tokens > 7 Tokens
Springfield 5 Tokens > 6 Tokens

General Faceit Improvements
Obviously, this is the first time anyone has attempted to embed Faceit’s competitive tools this deep into a game, so it’ll have some issues. However, the Faceit team and Bulkhead have been actively working on fixes and improvements through this weekend. We would like to also point out that many of you have asked ‘why am I getting matchmade with incredible players’. This is because we currently are gathering the data needed to determine who is good and who is… not so good! During this pre-season we’ll be tweaking the elo system and trying to find a great balance for Faceit Season 1.

The economy updates and Faceit improvements will be going live at approximately 17:00 BST, your Faceit server will not restart or close the servers will simply change over when the update goes live, you don’t need to lift a finger! However, a new client update is available to download now. Head over to Steam to get the new patch.

Blitzkrieg Battles Returns, Win $500!
The Plays have returned with Blitzkrieg Battles in the EU and NA. This week we see the first EU teams face off for first prize! Registration is now open, visit The Plays for more info!


See you in the servers!
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: New Map: Docks launching with full release!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/6de4dc3b059202ba807c2d61c6cb2c6b313aaec0.jpg

New map ‘Docks’ focuses on rewarding skilled players and decision making
Battalion 1944’s full release is just around the corner. On May 23rd a whole host of new maps will be available to players. Today we wanted to talk in a little more depth about ‘Docks’, check out this quick video explaining the thought process behind the design.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bV2X0TGGQdM&feature=youtu.be
Visuals
When we started playing our blockout/greybox version of the level. We knew we wanted to make something bright and vibrant so we pushed forward with Italy. We wanted to hark back to the bright COD2 maps based in Tunisia. So we found a region that worked for us and fit with our setting.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/10a4eed49a0453d9213d80845a91d75feb8948a6.jpg

Design
We wanted to bring back the verticality of Toujane. The feeling that if you perfect your movement, you can effectively ‘parkour’ along the rooftops is definitely something we had in mind when we were designing this map. In Wartide the creativity in your movement comes to life when a player is forced to ‘rotate’ (change bomb site). 
Docks is a small map compared to other Battalion maps, this makes for lots of quick rotations and double fakes. Information and communication is key on Docks.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/9b5a58c191206164f4b7e4ada5d314a2a353f640.jpg

Wartide Tips
The rooftops are powerful positions, but they are high risk positions. Attackers will often post up at a position where they can take aim at the rooftops and pick off any defenders trying to take a high ground position. Often when playing Docks, it will feel like a game of cat and mouse, gathering crumbs of information from quick head peaks and minor sounds. But in the last 20 seconds of the round the attackers have no choice but to crank up the aggression. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/75f31ad6488bbad485cde7b0fb8cea95782d7404.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/821069d5f8efbf521627f0575cb2aa5291565868.jpg
As an attacker on Docks, you’ll find more success if you make it a priority to pick off overextending defenders. Playing from far back and spreading across the map, only picking a bomb site once you have the numbers advantage in the late round. Do not give the defenders control of the rooftops, at any point. If you do, you’ll have real trouble trying to plant the bomb!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/e423c2cb5746ef3b7ab0c28d4337fdf0b083890a.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/3e848c5d55d8150432ebeef29681b0766917034c.jpg

If you have any questions about Docks, tweet @Battalion1944 or jump into the official discord and we’ll be happy to discuss them with you 

Tomorrow we’ll be discussing Goldrush, our new Arcade map designed for CTF play.
